paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," visually represents the proportional contribution of various data sources to the training dataset used in the study. The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, each corresponding to a specific data source and labeled with its name and percentage share. The largest segment is labeled "NQ" and occupies 31.3% of the chart, colored blue. The second largest is "FEVER" at 16.1%, colored teal. Following are "SNLI" at 15.4% (orange), "MULTINLI" at 11.3% (pink), "VITAMINC" at 13.0% (light teal), "ANLI" at 4.6% (orange-red), "FACTCC" at 2.6% (green), "ENTFA" at 1.8% (yellow), "SCITAIL" at 1.2% (dark green), and "PUBHEALTH" at 0.5% (light pink). The smallest slice, "XSUMHUL," accounts for 1.6% and is colored light blue. Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and connected by a thin line to its respective label, and the chart does not include a legend or exploded slices, presenting the data in a standard, proportional format.
